chunks: (Communion with Allāh:) The particular thing by which you should purify your religion for Allāh should be:

the fulfilment of those obligations which are especially for Him. Therefore, devote to Allāh some of your physical activity during the night and the day, and whatever (worship) you perform for seeking nearness to Allāh should be complete, without defect or deficiency, whatsoever physical exertion it may involve.
ai.seo_question: How should a Muslim ensure their worship is complete and dedicated solely to God according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this foundational text from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) defines the essence of private devotion as the rigorous execution of obligatory duties (Fara'id), demanding that the believer exhaust their physical capacity ('balagha min badanika') in worship. This instruction underscores the Shia emphasis on the inseparability of spiritual sincerity and physical discipline, ensuring that acts of worship are not merely performed but perfected without deficiency. It serves as a practical guide for both rulers and individuals to maintain spiritual integrity through consistent, wholehearted adherence to divine commands.
